source_findings.finding: The executor enforces one 360-second aggregate science-compute allowance shared across discovery and holdout. Before the holdout, it subtracts elapsed_seconds from both discovery Results and caps the holdout worker at the minimum of 120 seconds, the remaining shared compute allowance, and registered spec timeout. These checks do not measure or enforce the complete native workflow deadline.

source_findings.finding: A shared whole-child wall deadline exists in run_native_adaptive: its default is 600 seconds, it creates a monotonic deadline after context/preflight checks, passes it to the child, bounds child communication, and terminates the child/process group on timeout. The source accepts up to 720 seconds, so the published run's declared 600 seconds must remain the operative budget. The source does not derive this deadline from run_created.
